rationale: Dylan is building AI-powered career guidance at Casey AI with a conviction that AI solves the scaling problem in career advising; Wang has demonstrated unparalleled skill at scaling manufacturing operations and vertical integration across battery, motor, and semiconductor production at BYD. While their domains differ—edtech/consumer-AI versus autonomous vehicles and battery technology—both operate from a first-principles view that AI and vertical control of core components are decisive competitive moats, and both have domain expertise (Dylan in GTM and user research, Wang in large-scale production and technical strategy) that could sharpen each other's thinking on scaling challenges.
